evals.name: factory-stacked-milestones
evals.prompt: /pm-status 3d — I had orchestrate-issues grinding through the ledger milestones, catch me up
evals.expected_output: Groups stacked milestone PRs, distinguishes merged-to-main vs merged-to-stack, lists ready frontier issues as next steps
assertions: Report has Landed / In flight / Needs you / Next up sections
Report states the time window it covers
A verdict of at most two sentences and 40 words sits between the heading and the first bucket

Report has at most 3 plain-text pictures in fenced code blocks (aligned list, tree, step sequence, or diff), at least one when the data holds a stack, an epic, or a multi-step top action, and no Mermaid or HTML
Pictures keep what each item does: no picture row is a bare PR/issue number without a description

Next up has 2-6 numbered items, each with a reason; only the first may be a step sequence; every other item is one source line of at most 25 words with no nested bullets; cleanup sits on one unnumbered Cleanup line
Every Next up item names a concrete PR/issue number, branch, or session
Report is 70 lines or fewer
Report gives the outcome of at least one dispatched session, or, when no session source shows the work, says so and gives how that work ended from the PR trail
Stacked milestone PRs are grouped (not one bullet per sub-PR) and merged-to-stack vs merged-to-main is distinguished
Each Needs-you bullet is at most two sentences and 40 words after its bold lead-in
No Next-up reason restates the problem from its Needs-you bullet; it says why the item ranks there or what it unlocks
The report is the final message of the run: no tool call and no closing text follow it (the --mark call comes before it)
